text: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化中国资本市场发展特点规律研究。A股市场有2亿多股票投资者、8亿多基金持有人，这一国情市情在全球独一无二。这要求我们在市场建设中，既要研究借鉴成熟市场发展的一般规律，更要深入研究中国的市场特点和面临的结构性问题，坚持市场化、法治化、国际化改革方向的同时，统筹好稳与进、效率与公平、发展与安全等辩证关系，坚定走好中国特色金融发展之路。
text_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing, speaking at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference, said research into the characteristics and patterns of China's capital market development will be further deepened. The A-share market has more than 200 million stock investors and over 800 million fund holders—a national and market condition unique in the world. This requires that in building the market, we study and learn from the general patterns of mature market development while conducting deeper research into China's market characteristics and structural problems, and while adhering to the market-oriented, law-based and internationalized reform direction, coordinate dialectical relationships such as stability and progress, efficiency and equity, and development and security, and firmly follow the path of financial development with Chinese characteristics.
